name: Gin
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled gin. Has a strong, piney flavor.
instr: Ferment 2× jacksberries with water in a barrel. (yields 4 bottles, after 5 min)

name: Rice Spirit
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled rice spirit. Has a clean flavor and a dry finish.
instr: Ferment null with water in a barrel. (yields 4 bottles)

name: Voddena
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed voddena. Brewed from potatoes. It has a clean flavor.
instr: Ferment 12× potato cuts with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 5 min)

name: Onion Cognac
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed onion cognac. Weak, with a strong spicy, sweet and malty overtone.
instr: Ferment 6× onion with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 3 min)

name: Cider, Apple
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed apple cider. Has a sweet, crispy apple flavor.
instr: Ferment 6× apple with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 5 min)

name: Cider, Pear
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed pear cider. Has a sweet, subtle pear flavor.
instr: Ferment 6× pear with water in a barrel.

name: Cider, Strawberry
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed strawberry cider. Has a sweet, subtle strawberry flavor.
instr: Ferment 6× strawberry with water in a barrel.

name: Cider, Ambrosia
desc: A bottle of cider, faintly glowing with a golden hue. It holds the distilled essence of a divine fruit, made ludicrously intense for even the heartiest drinkers.
instr: Ferment 1× ambrosia, 5× sugar with water in a barrel. (yields 2 bottles, after 15 min)

name: Brandy, Apple
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled apple brandy. Has a slight caramel flavor.
instr: Ferment in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 4 min)

name: Brandy, Pear
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled pear brandy. Tastes of ripe pear, and a hint of spice.
instr: Ferment in a barrel.

name: Brandy, Strawberry
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled strawberry berry. Tastes of overwhelming sweetness with a smooth finish.
instr: Ferment in a barrel.

name: Brandy, Tangerine
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled tangerine brandy. Has a light, citrusty flavor with a hint of spice.
instr: Ferment in a barrel.

name: Brandy, Plum
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled plum brandy. Has a sweet, vanilla flavor.
instr: Ferment in a barrel.

name: Wheat Beer
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed wheat beer. Has a light flavor. Staple of the west.
instr: Ferment 6× wheat grain with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 2 min)

name: Oat Ale
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed oat ale. Has a rich, hearty flavor.
instr: Ferment 6× oat grain with water in a barrel.

name: Rice Wine
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed rice wine. Has a sweet, umami flavor.
instr: Ferment 6× rice grain with water in a barrel.

name: Fireleaf
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed fireleaf. Brewed from cabbage, it tastes absolutely awful.
instr: Ferment 6× cabbage with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 1 min)

name: Spider Honey Mead
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed spider honey mead. Taste the same as normal mead with a sweet flavor, but considered better and more refined.
instr: Ferment 6× spider honey with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 3 min)

name: Mead
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed mead. Has a sweet, honey-like flavor.
instr: Ferment 6× honey with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 3 min)

name: Wine, Jackberry

instr: Ferment 6× jacksberries with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 5 min)

name: Wine, Umeshu (Plum)

name: Wine, Tangerine

name: Wine, Raspberry

instr: Ferment 1× atropa, 1× sugar, 1× matricaria, 1× paris, 1× whip with water in a barrel. (yields 4 bottles, after 7 min)

name: Wine, Lux
desc: A potentially heretickal brew, Lux, when fermented, breaks down into Vitae, which can further ferment into a delectable wine.
instr: Ferment 1× impure lux, 2× sugar, 1× calendula with water in a barrel. (yields 2 bottles, after 5 min)

name: Wine, Spiced
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed spiced jackberry wine. Traditionally reserved for the holidaes, it still remains deliciously rich and aromatic all yil-round. Championed as a remedy for childhood ailments and injuries, courtesy of dwarven mothers.
instr: Ferment 2× jacksberries, 1× tangerine, 1× sugar, 1× pumpkin spice, 1× rocknut with water in a barrel. (yields 5 bottles, after 5 min)

name: Golden Calendula Tea
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed golden calendula tea. Has a herbal flavor.
instr: Ferment 1× calendula, 1× mentha, 1× spider honey with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 4 min)

name: Soothing Valerian Tea
desc: A bottle of locally-brewed soothing Valerian tea. Has a herbal flavor.
instr: Ferment 1× valeriana, 1× hypericum, 1× spider honey with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 4 min)

name: Noc Mash
desc: A bottle of harsh, grain-fortified distillate. An unfinished step toward Noc's Shine.
instr: Ferment 6× wheat grain with water in a barrel. (yields 4 bottles, after 5 min)

name: Noc's Shine
desc: An unmarked bottle with a distinctively blue-greenish liquor inside. Extremely potent, usable for cleaning wounds. Said to strengthen the body, and destroy the mind.
instr: Ferment 6× swampweed with water in a barrel. (yields 4 bottles, after 6 min)

name: Molasses
desc: A bottle of molasses. A thick, dark syrup made from sugar.
instr: Ferment 6× sugar with water in a barrel. (yields 6 bottles, after 3 min)

name: Rum
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled rum. Has a sweet flavor with a hints of caramel and vanilla.
instr: Ferment in a barrel. (yields 4 bottles, after 4 min)

name: Limoncello
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled limoncello. Has a sweet, citrusy and burning flavor.
instr: Ferment 2× lemon, 1× sugar with water in a barrel. (yields 4 bottles, after 4 min)

name: Crab, Fermented
desc: Fermented. Crab. One barrel of this triples the brothel's earnings for the week. A man thinks he's done, drinks a mouthful of this. Five minutes later he's back in the race.
instr: Ferment 2× crab meat, 2× sugar, 1× viscera, 1× valeriana with water in a barrel. (yields 2 bottles, after 7 min)

name: Medicinal Fish Vinegear, Fermented
desc: Overpoweringly fishy, yet imbued with alchemical mirth. An ancient predecessor to refined lifeblood, more commonly diluted in the modern dae for use as a savory sauce. (Un)fortuantely, this batch isn't destinted for dilution.
instr: Ferment 3× fish filet, 1× sugar, 1× salt, 1× calendula with water in a barrel. (yields 2 bottles, after 15 min)

name: Aqua Vitae - Apple
desc: A bottle of locally-distilled aqua vitae, distilled twice from cider then brandy, suitable for medicinal purposes. Not advised for drinking.
instr: Ferment in a barrel. (yields 2 bottles, after 4 min)
